test_title: PYST 12: RRB NTPC (UG) CBT-I - GA (Held On: 12 Aug, 2025 Shift 3)
subject: general
question: What was the main aim of TRYSEM (Training for Rural Youth for Self-Employment)?

options.text: Offering free education in rural areas
Upgrading skills of rural youth to tackle unemployment

solution:
The Correct answer is __**Upgrading skills of rural youth to tackle unemployment**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **TRYSEM** stands for **Training for Rural Youth for Self Employment**.
 
• The program was launched by the **Government of India in 1979** as a part of the Integrated Rural Development Program (IRDP).
 
• The primary aim of TRYSEM was to provide **technical and entrepreneurial skills** to rural youth between the ages of **18 to 35 years**, enabling them to find self-employment opportunities.
 
• It focused on providing training in various **vocational skills**, such as **carpentry, tailoring, mechanics, masonry, and other trades**, which were demand-driven and suited for rural areas.
 
• The program targeted economically and socially weaker sections, including **Scheduled Castes (SC), Scheduled Tribes (ST), women, and other underprivileged groups**.
 
• TRYSEM aimed to reduce rural **unemployment** and enhance the productivity of youth by aligning their skills with local employment opportunities.
 
• It was implemented through **collaboration** between government agencies, non-government organizations (NGOs), and private institutions.
 
• Post-training, the participants were often provided assistance to start their own enterprises or were linked with credit schemes like **IRDP** to help them establish their businesses.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• **Offering free education in rural areas**__

 __
 
• This option refers to initiatives aimed at providing free education to rural communities, but it is unrelated to TRYSEM, which is focused on skill development for self-employment.
 
• Programs like **Samagra Shiksha** or **Mid-Day Meal Scheme** are examples of government efforts to improve education access in rural India.
 
 
 
• **Providing loans to farmers**__
 __
 
• This option focuses on financial assistance to farmers, typically offered through schemes like **Kisan Credit Card (KCC)** or **PM Kisan Yojana**.
 
• While TRYSEM indirectly helped beneficiaries by linking them with credit schemes, its main objective was skill development, not direct loan provision.
 
 
 
• **Building infrastructure in villages**__
 
 
• Building rural infrastructure is often the focus of programs like **PMGSY (Pradhan Mantri Gram Sadak Yojana)** or **MGNREGA (Mahatma Gandhi National Rural Employment Guarantee Act)**.
 
• TRYSEM did not focus on physical infrastructure development but rather on human resource development.
